Radar Charts: When on the roster page, the radar chart shows a player's rating breakdown and their potential rating over it. The same goes for the radar chart on the team biography popup window.
Team Weaknesses: Your team's weaknesses are compared to the average of the rest of the league. Depending on your gameplan, a stated weaknesses may not be an actual weakness to you.
Rivals: The rivals shown to you are teams that are either based in the same state as you or have a similar record or overall team rating.
Player Stat Ratings: The stat ratings for each player depend on several factors such as rating, archetype and even physical attributes such as height and weight.
Awards: Each award (MVP, DPOY, ROTY and All-Stars) all take into account different factors when deciding the top candidates for the award. Naturally there will still be award-snubs.
